newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end down on profit-taking in cement.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end down on profit-taking in cement.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended slightly down on Thursday due to profit-taking in blue chips, particularly cement stocks and Telkom, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed down 0.71 points, or 0.10 percent, at 721.27 points after touching an intra-day high of 724.25 points and an intra-day low of 717.00 points.
Losers led gainers by 71 to 62, with 70 counters unchanged.

"Compared to Wednesday, the correction today is relatively small. It is mostly due to profit-taking in blue chip stocks which made strong gains recently," said Tony Visianto, an analyst at Dongsuh Kolibindo Perkasa brokerage.

Large selling interest in Semen Gresik was partly due to a company official saying that net profits during the year were not encouraging although sales during the first half of 1997 were higher than the same period last year, brokers said.
"Total sales volume was higher than the same period last yera, but it did not reflect the firm's net profit performance," Koestoro, Semen Gresik's investor relations officer, told Reuters.
On the other hand, there was buying interest in Semen Cibinong following reports of a planned bonus issue, brokers said.

A broker with a Singapore firm predicted that the index would move within a narrow range on Friday. "I do not expect any fresh strong positive news tomorrow which could boost sentiment. Also, investors are still waiting for further stabilisation in the foreign exchange market," she added.
Paper and pulp producer Indah Kiat topped the active list with about 21.7 million shares traded but fell on profit-taking. It closed 25 rupiah lower at 1,350 rupiah.
Medium-sized Bank Arya, which made its debut, was also active. It closed at 1,150 rupiah, against an offer price of 975 rupiah, on a volume of about 16 million shares.
